requirements.notes: AUTOMATED — the entire grid math is pure and unit-tested (node --test lib/*.test.ts → 107/107 green, incl. these 8 new tests: 3 remainder + 5 interiorModuleLines, run in-loop). Verified firsthand: (a) the per-axis remainders (dim − floor(dim/m)·m) pinned at even → 0, off-grid → signed leftover, and parity with layoutRoom2D's rightStrip/bottomStrip on the shared length/width axes; (b) interiorModuleLines pinned for exact-fit (drops the coincident far-edge line), off-grid (keeps the last whole line before the remainder), count parity with layoutRoom3D cols/rows/layers, sub-module (empty), and the m<=0 guard. CR-001 (low, resolved): the riskiest logic — the exact-fit-vs-off-grid interior-line filter — was extracted from a module-private helper into the pure, tested interiorModuleLines engine helper shared by Viz2D and the 3D lattice, so an off-by-one can no longer silently ship. MANUAL — the canvas render itself is not covered by an automated runner (ADR-0001: no React/WebGL/canvas harness in this repo): that the lattice <lineSegments> actually tiles each box on the M step, that the remainder <mesh> slabs appear on off-grid far faces and vanish on exact fit, that the single accent cube still reads as the only saturated element (FR-VIZ3D-03 preserved — lattice/slabs are faint/neutral), that MAX_LATTICE_DIVISIONS=40 degrades gracefully for tiny-module rooms, and the inherited WebGL-off→Viz2D fallback + reduced-motion — are covered by the manual test plan docs/qa/test-plans/viz-3d-grid.md. spec_compliant: verified against all six spec.md scenarios and PDR L177 — grid math (floor cells + interior lines + signed remainder) matches the FR-VIZ2D-02 rule mirrored into 3D, confirmed by the parity test and the resolved CR-001.
